content: पांस(श)न {%a.%} (-ना, -नी|{%f.%}) (Usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Disgracing, dishonouring, defiling; सदस्पतीनतिक्रम्य गोपालः कुलपांसनः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 74. 34</ls>; पौलस्त्यकुलपांसन <ls>Mv. 5</ls>. .²2 Vitiating, spoiling. .²3 Wicked, contemptible. .²4 Infamous. .{@-नम्@} Contempt.
